posts.subject: [SURF DM] Season System
posts.bodyHtml:
Oh hello dear community.


I'm here to suggest something especially to the chief of the SDM.


I know the SDM server reset sometimes. But why don't we make a "Season" System with the reset. I mean, each year a new season starts. It's kind of a competition. The top 3 players could help you to choose the new power of the next season or something else (You're the judge) but I think it could be a great thing to have into the community to make it more active and to make a little challenge against each regular player on the SDM server.


I don't know if it's clear enough for you, but for me it is (Thanks for my bad english 🙁 )


So yeah, here's my suggestion about the SDM [^^]

We just reseted the system for important changes. So restets are not plenad.


U may have noticed that our users are angry about that.
I dont think that it would be a good idea if we reset the rpg system in seasons...


Just my opinion...

That was just an idea. I know many users are pissed off about the reset but yeah... I think it's normal to reset the server sometimes beceause new user are quickly disgusted because of Uber powered player that play on the server from the beginning. That's why I suggested that
